texts.label: R1057, Berlin, 4 Feb 1792, Van Reede to William V
texts.summary: A cover note, not a despatch: Van Reede warns the Prince's secretary Thomas Isaac de Larrey that the real letter is written in lemon juice on the four blank half-pages of the enclosure, to be handed to the Prince of Orange; the last 21 groups are declared nulls.
